release: TASK-015 Slices 2+3 — listing reports, moderator API and owner moderation notices
rollback_note: No schema change: the Slice 1 schema (a3c5e7f9b1d4) carries reports, decisions and TRANSACTIONAL inbox notices. Rollback to Slice 1 is nevertheless BLOCKED as an operational policy: once users file reports and moderators and owners rely on this loop, the Slice 1 build removes report intake and every moderator HTTP operation (holds could no longer be released over HTTP) while the reports and decisions stay in the database. Recovery is forward repair, not a restart of the previous image.
